MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 72

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 57

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 12

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 43

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 24

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

9. Solve for x: x + 9 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 9

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
